# Public wallet vectors

These mnemonics and seeds are published test vectors. Never fund them.

- `icarus.json`: CIP-0003 Icarus test vectors, empty and `foo` passphrases,
  <https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/blob/master/CIP-0003/Icarus.md>.
  The tests compare all 96 root-key bytes before child derivation.
- `shelley.json`: cardano-addresses golden addresses at revision
  `c75167069e954ae4f7b42df0d2db3828869be8c7`, file
  `test/golden/addresses_test_walk_nut_penalty_hip_pave_soap_entry_language_right_filter_choice/actual`,
  <https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-addresses/tree/c75167069e954ae4f7b42df0d2db3828869be8c7/test/golden>.
  Enterprise and base addresses independently anchor the CIP-1852 payment and
  staking paths; the signing test checks the key against the published credential.
- `ed25519.json`: RFC 8032 section 7.1, TEST 1,
  <https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8032#section-7.1>.
  This separately anchors the signature primitive against a published signature;
  it is not an Icarus extended-private-key derivation vector.

The derived-wallet signing test verifies the actual wallet signature and rejects
a changed message. No expected wallet signature was generated by the implementation
under test. Address network IDs 0 and 1 share credentials; unsupported network IDs
and account indices at or above 2^31 must fail.
